set.body:
Found by codex-storymodel-research-spike (item 8), walking the raw-text path as an outsider.

THERE IS NO ADMITTED-STORY LOADER. docs/design/war-of-the-ghosts-boas1901.txt carries an admission
header with provenance metadata, exactly as docs/design/story-text-admission-checklist.md requires.
But passing that file to StorySource.fromText WOULD MAKE THE PROVENANCE METADATA PART OF THE STORY.
There is no machine-readable boundary between header and text, and no loader that knows about one.

The spike had to write its own header-skipping parser to proceed. That is a small thing for one
agent and a systematic one for the project: EVERY consumer of an admitted text will write their
own, they will not agree, and the differences will be invisible because each will produce a
plausible StorySource.

WHY THIS IS TIMELY RATHER THAN MERELY OPEN. The admission checklist and the 17-story manifest are
the mechanism by which real texts enter this repository, and they are currently blocked on the
owner's PD sign-off. THE MOMENT THAT SIGN-OFF LANDS, seventeen texts arrive in this format and
every one of them hits this gap. Fixing it before the corpus exists costs one loader; fixing it
after costs one loader plus reconciling however many ad-hoc parsers have appeared.

REQUIRED: a loader that takes an admitted story file and returns the text AND its admission record
as separate typed values. The header is provenance -- edition, licence, checksum, admission basis --
and it belongs in the receipt, not in the prose. The checksum in the header should be verified
against the text it precedes, which the current arrangement cannot do because nothing knows where
one ends and the other begins.

RELATED FRICTION from the same log, same root cause: the WOG raw text exists TWICE -- as
docs/design/war-of-the-ghosts-boas1901.txt and as WarOfTheGhostsText.scala -- with no statement of
which is authoritative. The spike hesitated and chose the admitted file because the directive said
raw text. A loader plus a stated authority would resolve both.

Not urgent this hour. Should be done before the corpus lands, not after.
set.title: acquire/core: there is no admitted-story loader - provenance headers have no machine-readable boundary, so every consumer writes its own parser
